main_measure.name: slope of next-day excess return on abs(forecast), short bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t <= -2 (with mean excess < 0); reject if slope t >= +2

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return on short bars

decided_by: The slope's t is between -2 and +2. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction +0.745 (below 1), 492 cases (30 needed).
reading: Profile bars are those with regime 'unknown' (the detector's only non-vetoed regime, i.e. falling and agitated), up days are a positive raw scaled return (price change when unrecorded), every short bar with a next close in its window is used (1-bar horizon grid), and the slope's t uses cluster-robust (CR1) standard errors clustered by UTC day.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +0.745 (below 1), 492 cases (30 needed)
